summary: The proposal presents a coherent and technically concrete access-management project, with four actionable objectives, two diagrams, a detailed schedule, and an adequate peer-reviewed research base. Before acceptance, add the missing Abstract, remove the solution proposal from the Problem section, revise the double-verb objective, move the Keycloak documentation to a footnote, expand Figure 2's caption, eliminate the contraction, add explicit AI-output review confirmation, and remove thesis-writing/presentation tasks from the development schedule. Also add introductory prose before subsection 1.1 and correct the citation placed after a full stop.

findings.title: Required Abstract is missing
findings.description: Add the required Abstract section before the Introduction. It should summarise the problem, motivation, objectives, and planned approach in roughly one-third to one-half page.

findings.title: Problem section proposes a solution
findings.description: Remove this proposed solution from the Problem section. Keep the section limited to the current process, its stakeholders, and negative consequences; move the platform proposal to Motivation or Objective.

locations.quote: A self-service platform that arms the workflow engine of Keycloak with an expiry date at grant time would end this accumulation.

findings.title: Objective combines two verbs
findings.description: Use one action per objective, for example “Implement connectors with expiry” or “Specify connectors with expiry,” rather than combining two verbs in one objective.

locations.quote: Design and implement connectors with expiry

findings.title: Figure 2 has a generic caption
findings.description: Expand the caption to explain the architecture’s components, their responsibilities, and the principal connections shown. “System Architecture” alone is not an informative caption.

findings.title: Contraction used in formal prose
findings.description: Replace the contraction with its non-contracted form (“does not”). Search for and remove any other contractions throughout the proposal.

locations.quote: The current process doesn’t scale and is the worst bottleneck of the chair.

findings.title: AI statement lacks review confirmation
findings.description: Add a review-confirmation sentence to the AI transparency statement explicitly stating that you carefully checked all AI-generated text for correctness and sense.

locations.section: Transparency in the Use of AI Tools
locations.quote: I used the following generative artificial intelligence (AI) tool while preparing this proposal.

findings.title: Citation appears after the full stop
findings.description: Move the citation before the preceding full stop so the sentence follows the required placement style: “...temporal model [BBF01].” Check the document for the same pattern elsewhere.

locations.quote: temporal    model.    [BBF01]     Joshi  et  al. generalise   this  idea  to  role  assignments

findings.title: Internet documentation is listed in the bibliography
findings.description: Move this documentation source out of the bibliography and place it in a footnote at its first use. The bibliography should contain scientific peer-reviewed publications only.

findings.title: Introduction begins directly with a subsection
findings.description: Add a short introductory paragraph immediately after the Introduction heading and before subsection 1.1, explaining the purpose and scope of the chapter.
